Thousands Protest in Delhi Demanding Election Chief's Resignation

Thousands of people protested in India's capital, Delhi, demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner. Opposition parties united to organize the rally, which was described by a Congress leader as a 'warning' to Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah. Some reports indicated tens of thousands participated in the demonstration.
